about: Diagrams a board can be started from. Each is a list of items as an MCP client would write them (kind, words, a box, and for a connector the ids it joins), so the canvas (model/templates.ts) and the server (App\Support\Board\Templates) read the same list.

templates.label: Flowchart
templates.about: Steps and a decision, from a start to an end.

templates.label: Swimlanes
templates.about: Who does what, in a lane each, with the work crossing between them.

items.text: Says it is on the way

templates.label: Org chart
templates.about: Who reports to whom, from the top down.

templates.label: Mind map
templates.about: One idea in the middle, and what comes off it.

templates.label: Sequence
templates.about: Who asks whom for what, in the order it happens.

templates.label: Data model
templates.about: Tables with their columns and keys, and each foreign key drawn to the column it points at.

templates.label: Class diagram
templates.about: Classes with their fields and methods: which is a kind of which, and which is made of which.

items.text: A hollow arrow reads "is a kind of"; a diamond, "is made of".

templates.label: Architecture
templates.about: What a system is made of and what talks to what.

templates.label: Roadmap
templates.about: What is being done now, what comes next, and what can wait.

templates.label: Retro
templates.about: What went well, what to improve, and what to do about it.
